criteria.text: AC-1: the unchanged representative PDF and all 36 stored labels are scored from sequential overlapping tiles; report recall at similarity 0.8, mean character similarity, 16-label small-text recovery, wall time, process RSS, cgroup peak, timeout/OOM state and corpus hashes. AC-2: ship no fallback unless recall >=95%, mean similarity >=0.90, small labels >=15/16, wall <180s, process RSS <2.8 GiB and service peak <4 GiB. AC-3: if shipped, fallback is PDF-only, on-demand after empty conversion, concurrency-bounded, sequential and fail-closed below the existing 50-character floor. AC-4: focused tests/benchmark plus pnpm type-check and pnpm build pass; no forbidden live/schema actions occur.
